question: Can source-only bracket redundancy identify row-wise exposure-gain nuisance before the unchanged P3T inverse, closing the frozen P3U residual and separation gates without reading any target?

estimator.name: bounded bracket errors-in-variables source normalizer
estimator.base_update: per-pattern arithmetic mean of gain-corrected source divided by nominal exposure scale
estimator.gain_update: per-row least-squares scalar through origin against nominal exposure scale times current base
estimator.gauge: role-wide geometric mean gain equals one
estimator.maximum_absolute_relative_gain: two times the regime maximum absolute source gain jitter

unchanged_evaluation.truth_cases: exact P3T six pure plus two mixed cases
unchanged_evaluation.mechanism_candidates: exact P3T physical and lens families
unchanged_evaluation.automatic_gates: exact P3U per-regime and common gates

controls: source-only normalizer with no target or outcome access
forbidden: change P3U observations, cases, regimes or gates after scoring
read targets while estimating row gains
use truth gain jitter at runtime
change iteration count, gauge, bounds or estimator after scoring
claim measured film, calibrated acquisition or product readiness

branch_rule.pass: Retain bracket-normalized recovery and specify a minimal controlled acquisition protocol before real-data work.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact source-only EIV estimator without same-cohort rescue; retain P3T only under its clean synthetic envelope.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic source-only bracket-normalization evidence under the exact P3U uncertainty observations; no real-film measurement, calibration or product claim.
